comments.headline: Trees violate distribution conductor clearance zones
comments.summary: Non-utility-compatible and large trees are positioned directly on or within prohibited clearance zones from overhead electric distribution conductors, with no documented Austin Energy approval for the placement.
comments.applicableArea: Southern property boundary along Valley View Road
comments.crossDep: Austin Energy — clearance variance approval may be required
comments.attn: Critical safety hazard. Trees must be relocated beyond minimum clearance distances (15 feet for non-UC species; 25 feet for large trees) or documented Austin Energy approval must be obtained authorizing placement within restricted zones.

details.text: Non-utility-compatible species (Cedar Elm, Live Oak) are positioned within the 15-foot restricted zone adjacent to distribution conductors. No Austin Energy approval is documented.

runComments.comment: Six mitigation trees shown directly on overhead electric line on landscape plan, with no clearance maintained from distribution conductor and no UC status documented for proposed species in plant schedule.
Non-utility-compatible trees (Cedar Elm, Live Oak) are being planted within the 15-foot restricted zone adjacent to overhead electric distribution lines. No Austin Energy approval is documented.

Non-utility-compatible trees (Cedar Elm, Live Oak) are positioned along the overhead electric distribution line boundary on the landscape plan without documented clearance verification or Austin Energy written approval. Provide documented Austin Energy approval authorizing these species within the restricted zone, or relocate trees to beyond 15 lateral feet from the outside conductor.

details.text: Large trees (Cedar Elm 40–50 ft, Live Oak 50–80 ft, Hackberry 40–60 ft mature height per ECM Appendix F) are positioned within the 25-foot minimum clearance zone from distribution conductors.

runComments.comment: Large trees (Live Oak and Cedar Elm with mature heights 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) shown directly on distribution OHE line on landscape plan, violating 25-foot minimum clearance from distribution conductors.

Large trees (Cedar Elm and Live Oak, both 40+ feet mature height per ECM Appendix F) are proposed within 25 feet of overhead electric distribution lines without documented clearance verification or Austin Energy approval.

Large trees (Cedar Elm at 40-50 feet, Live Oak at 50-80 feet, Hackberry at 40-60 feet mature height) are positioned along the overhead electric distribution line without documented clearance verification or Austin Energy approval. Provide clearance calculations or documented Austin Energy approval for trees within 25 feet of the distribution conductor, or relocate large trees to beyond 25 lateral feet from the outside conductor.

details.text: Six mitigation trees are shown directly on the overhead electric line with no documented written Austin Energy approval authorizing species, locations, or sizes within restricted zones.

runComments.comment: Six trees positioned directly on overhead electric line without documented written approval from Austin Energy authorizing the clearance variance.

Trees are proposed within prohibited clearance zones (non-UC Cedar Elm and Live Oak within 15 feet of overhead distribution line). No documented Austin Energy written approval is provided. Applicant must obtain explicit written approval from Austin Energy or modify tree species/locations to comply with clearance requirements.

Trees are positioned within prohibited electrical clearance zones without documented written approval from Austin Energy. Obtain and submit explicit written approval from Austin Energy authorizing the proposed tree placement (species, locations, and sizes) within restricted zones, or relocate all trees to comply with minimum clearance distances (15 feet from distribution conductors for non-utility-compatible trees, 25 feet for large trees, 10 feet from utility poles).

details.text: Trees are positioned directly on the OHE distribution line indicating zero clearance; no clearance distances documented or dimensioned on the landscape plan.

runComments.comment: Trees are shown directly on overhead electric line, indicating zero clearance maintained from distribution conductor. No clearance distances documented or dimensioned.

comments.headline: Tree clearances from utility poles undocumented
comments.summary: Clearance distances between proposed trees and utility poles are not dimensioned on the landscape plan, preventing verification that trees meet the 10-foot minimum lateral clearance requirement from poles.
comments.attn: Run 3 escalated status from 'not-verifiable' to 'fail,' indicating trees are positioned along OHE boundary where poles are located. Dimension utility pole locations on landscape plan and document clearances demonstrating minimum 10 lateral feet from each pole.

details.text: Utility pole locations not clearly dimensioned on landscape plan relative to proposed tree locations. Trees are positioned along the OHE line boundary where utility poles are located; provide clearance documentation demonstrating at least 10 lateral feet from each pole.

runComments.comment: Utility poles exist on site but clearance distances from proposed trees to poles are not dimensioned or documented on landscape plan.
Utility pole locations are not clearly dimensioned on the landscape plan relative to proposed tree locations. Clearance verification cannot be completed from available documentation.

Trees are positioned along the OHE line boundary where utility poles are located. Provide clearance documentation demonstrating all trees are at least 10 lateral feet from each pole, or relocate trees to meet this clearance requirement.

comments.headline: Underground electric equipment clearances not documented
comments.summary: Distances between proposed trees and underground electrical equipment (pull boxes, vaults, pad-mounted transformers) are not dimensioned or overlaid on the landscape plan, preventing verification of required clearances. Root barrier details are not provided for trees within 20 feet of underground equipment.
comments.attn: Overlay underground equipment locations from electrical plan (Sheet 21) onto landscape plan (Sheet 31). For any trees within 20 feet of underground equipment, provide root barrier details on landscape detail sheets (minimum 4-foot depth, 5-foot offset from equipment), or document that all trees are beyond 20 feet from underground equipment.

details.text: Underground electric equipment locations from the electrical plan (Sheet 21) are not shown on the landscape plan (Sheet 31). Clearance dimensions from proposed and retained trees to all underground equipment are not provided.

runComments.comment: Distances between proposed trees and underground electrical equipment not documented on plans.
Specific locations of underground electrical equipment are not dimensioned relative to tree placements. Clearance verification cannot be determined from available documentation.

Underground electric equipment locations from electrical plan (Sheet 21) are not shown on landscape plan (Sheet 31). Provide landscape plan with underground equipment (pull boxes, vaults) overlaid and labeled, with clearance dimensions from proposed and retained trees to all underground equipment, or add dimension callouts demonstrating trees are at least 5 lateral feet from all underground equipment.

details.text: Pad-mounted equipment locations are not dimensioned relative to proposed tree placements on the landscape plan. Clearance verification cannot be completed from available documentation.

runComments.comment: Pad-mounted equipment locations are not dimensioned relative to proposed tree placements on the landscape plan. Clearance verification cannot be completed from available documentation.

details.text: Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment are not identified on the landscape plan. Root barrier specifications (minimum 4-foot depth, 5-foot offset from equipment) are not provided on landscape detail sheets.

runComments.comment: Root barrier specifications, depths, and positions not documented for trees within 20 feet of underground electrical equipment.
Trees within 20 feet of underground electrical equipment are not identified on the landscape plan, and root barrier specifications for such locations are not shown on landscape details.

For any trees proposed within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment, provide root barrier details on a landscape detail sheet specifying minimum 4-foot depth and 5-foot offset from equipment. Alternatively, provide landscape plan documentation showing all trees are beyond 20 feet from underground equipment.

comments.headline: Tree species and sizes not differentiated on plans
comments.summary: Large trees (mature height ≥40 feet) are not visually distinguished on the landscape plan, and tree species are not keyed by legend or labeled directly on the plan. The plant schedule lists installation heights only, not mature heights, making it impossible to identify which trees are subject to large-tree clearance restrictions.
comments.attn: Adding mature height notes to the plant schedule and using distinct symbols or notation on the landscape plan to identify large trees (Cedar Elm ~40–50 ft, Live Oak ~50–80 ft, Hackberry ~40–60 ft) will facilitate verification of electrical clearance compliance.

details.text: Large trees (Cedar Elm ~40–50 ft, Live Oak ~50–80 ft, Hackberry ~40–60 ft per ECM Appendix F) are not differentiated on the landscape plan or identified in the plant schedule by mature height, only by installation size (16' minimum).

runComments.comment: Live Oak and Cedar Elm are large trees (40+ feet mature height per ECM Appendix F) but plant schedule does not differentiate or identify them as large trees; only planting size (16' minimum) is documented.

Large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) are not visually differentiated on the landscape plan. Plant schedule lists installation heights (16'), not mature heights, making it difficult to identify trees subject to large-tree clearance restrictions.

Large trees (mature height ≥40 feet) are not differentiated on the landscape plan. Add a note to the plant schedule specifying mature height for each proposed tree species, and use a distinct symbol or notation on the landscape plan to identify large trees (Cedar Elm ~40-50 ft, Live Oak ~50-80 ft, Hackberry ~40-60 ft) to allow verification of electrical clearance compliance.

details.text: Trees proposed near electric facilities on the landscape plan are not identified by species using a keyed legend; species identification requires manual cross-reference to a separate plant list rather than direct labeling on the plan.

runComments.comment: Trees proposed near electric facilities on the landscape plan are not identified by species using a keyed legend. Species identification requires manual cross-reference to a separate plant list rather than direct labeling on the plan.

comments.headline: Clearance distances from trees not dimensioned
comments.summary: No dimension lines are provided on the landscape plan showing clearances from trees to overhead electric conductors. Measurement reference points (trunk center vs. canopy edge) and measurement methodology cannot be verified from available documentation.
comments.applicableArea: Landscape plan trees near overhead electric line
comments.attn: Add dimension lines to the landscape plan showing measured clearances from tree trunks to nearest conductor or pole. Specify whether measurements are taken from trunk center or from canopy perimeter edge, and confirm all clearances meet minimum standards per UCM § 1.10.10.4.

details.text: No clearance dimensions are provided on landscape plan showing tree-to-conductor distances. Measurement methodology and reference points cannot be verified from the plans.

runComments.comment: No clearance dimensions provided on plans; measurement methodology cannot be verified.
No dimension lines are provided on the landscape plan showing tree clearances from overhead electric conductors. Measurement methodology cannot be verified.

details.text: No dimension lines show whether tree clearances were measured from tree trunk centers or from canopy edges. Reference point methodology cannot be verified from available documentation.

runComments.comment: No clearance dimensions provided on landscape plan; measurement reference point (trunk vs. canopy) cannot be verified.
No dimension lines on the landscape plan show whether tree clearances were measured from tree trunk centers or canopy edges. Measurement methodology cannot be verified from available documentation.

comments.headline: Voltage classification of overhead electric lines not specified
comments.summary: The voltage classification of existing overhead electric lines (transmission ≥60 kV vs. distribution <60 kV) is not specified on the plans. Without this information, compliance with applicable clearance requirements cannot be verified.
comments.crossDep: Austin Energy — voltage classification confirmation required
comments.attn: Obtain from Austin Energy or the electrical utility the voltage classification for all existing overhead electric lines on or adjacent to the property. If transmission-class (≥60 kV), verify 50-foot clearance; if distribution (<60 kV), verify appropriate distribution clearances per UCM § 1.10.10.4.

details.text: Voltage classification of overhead electric lines is not specified on plans (Sheets 21, 31). Cannot determine if transmission (≥60 kV) or distribution (<60 kV) classification applies to verify 50-foot transmission clearance compliance.

runComments.comment: Voltage classification of existing overhead electric lines not specified on plans. Cannot determine if transmission (≥60kV) or distribution (<60kV) classification applies, and therefore cannot verify compliance with 50-foot transmission clearance requirement.

details.text: Voltage classification not specified on plans. Cannot independently verify transmission clearance compliance without confirmation that the overhead electric line is transmission-class (≥60 kV).

runComments.comment: Voltage classification not specified. Cannot independently verify transmission clearance compliance without confirmation that OHE is transmission-class (≥60kV).
